card.name: Hyphenated words inside URL slugs
card.fires_on: Hyphens and short linking words (y, a, for, of, the, across) inside long hyphen-joined URL slugs or hyphenated names, just before the next hyphenated word.

modes.label: URL slug links
modes.description: Small words or hyphens joining words in a news article URL path.

modes.label: Hyphenated name phrases
modes.description: Words inside quoted hyphen-joined names or bullet lists.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of web addresses and hyphen-joined phrases, where words are strung together with dashes.
